description: This source file defines a ListFragment subclass called PopupListFragment for managing a list of cheeses. It includes an inner class PopupAdapter for rendering list items with popup menu buttons, and handles user interactions such as item clicks and popup menu actions, specifically removing cheeses from the list.

classes.name: PopupListFragment
classes.description: A ListFragment subclass that displays a list of cheeses. Each list item includes a button which, when clicked, shows a popup menu for item actions such as removal.

classes.name: PopupAdapter
classes.description: An ArrayAdapter subclass that manages the views for each cheese item, attaching a popup button with a click listener to show contextual menus.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Initializes the list with cheese data by copying from Cheeses.CHEESES into an ArrayList and setting the adapter.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles clicks on list items by displaying a toast message with the clicked cheese item.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles clicks on the popup button within each list item. Posts a Runnable to show the popup menu positioned correctly.

methods.name: showPopupMenu
methods.description: Creates and displays a PopupMenu aligned to the clicked button, inflates menu options, and handles item selection to remove the cheese from the list.
